item.title: Mamdani administration secures landmark injunction against Bronx landlord
item.description: The first-of-its-kind judgement was against the landlord of 919 Prospect Ave., who now faces the maximum penalties, including more than $2.1 million for retroactive punishments.

item.title: Olympic gold medalist Alysa Liu honored at Oakland City Hall rally
item.description: Oakland, California, honored its latest hometown hero, gold medalist Alysa Liu, with a large celebration and rally.

item.title: Ernie Anastos, iconic New York anchor who spent 11 years at WABC-TV, dies at 82
item.description: Ernie Anastos spent 11 years as an anchor at Eyewitness News beginning in the late '70s before he left in 1989.

item.title: Suspect charged with pushing 2 men onto subway tracks in country illegally from Honduras
item.description: Bairon Hernandez has convictions in New Jersey and Texas for entering the country illegally.

item.title: New York City can enforce bill banning sale of foie gras, appeals court rules
item.description: The goose may be cooked for French restaurants fighting a ban on foie gras.

item.title: 'Mormon Wives' tackles secrets, lies and relationship resets in season four
item.description: #MomTok drama reaches new heights in season four of "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives." The entire season is now streaming on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Slain NYPD detective's widow gives emotional testimony in murder trial
item.description: The widow of an NYPD detective who was shot and killed in Queens in 2024 took the stand on Thursday.

item.title: Ceremonial train ride marks completion of Phase 1 of Portal Bridge changeover
item.description: On Monday, the new track is expected to be open to riders and schedules return to some sense of normalcy -- at least for now.

item.title: NYPD increases patrols at Jewish sites after synagogue attack in Michigan
item.description: Out of an abundance of caution, the NYPD has deployed high visibility patrols Friday morning outside Jewish institutions after Thursday's chaotic scene in Bloomfield, Michigan, as a Lebanese man rammed his car through the front doors of a synagogue.

item.title: AccuWeather: Clouding up, brisk
item.description: Winter is making a brief but noticeable comeback, with snow showers, freezing temperatures and gusty winds affecting the Tri‑State area.
